shared_rules: Freeze all fixtures and algorithms before scientific trials; input-only deterministic selection rules are part of fixtures.
All results remain observations until independent review and a committed Coordinator decision.
Retain every mismatch, invalid row, resource-censored row and exceptional branch; no adaptive replacement.
Do not extrapolate finite exact witnesses to cryptographic-size prime groups or a sub-rho attack.
A/A reorders only a declared nuisance factor; positive controls must be detected and negative controls retained.
No clock is a primary metric; operation counts describe these implementations and count setup, selection, failed attempts and checking separately.
Performance hypotheses in the original proposals remain open when only correspondence/instrument gates are evaluated.
